blockedIdentities.reason: The raw name STS is a generic abbreviation. STS Sensor Technik Sirnach AG is a plausible industrial-sensor match, but the queue record alone does not provide a discriminator that safely excludes other STS manufacturers.
No manufacturer-owned corporate domain could be tied unambiguously to the UDICOM queue identity.

The historical Dutch AMCA Hydraulic Controls identity is supported only by third-party catalog traces; the manufacturer-owned domain is unavailable and the current similarly named Dubai site is a distributor, not acceptable primary evidence.
KISSLING can refer to the Swiss gearbox manufacturer or the TE Connectivity relay and switch brand; the raw queue identity does not safely resolve the conflict.
The LONNE name does not uniquely identify a manufacturer; multiple unrelated Lonne/Loenne industrial and service businesses were found without a queue-level discriminator.
A reachable manufacturer-owned source establishing the PELIKAN VRCHLABI identity and current product scope could not be located.
DIEMME is used by two active Italian equipment manufacturers, Diemme Filtration and DIEMME Enologia. The raw identity does not identify which entity is intended.
LVF is a generic abbreviation and the surfaced valve sites do not provide enough manufacturer-owned corporate evidence to resolve the intended entity safely.
No authoritative manufacturer-owned source establishing the MAS LAMBERTONI identity and product scope was available.

profiles.shortDescription: Leine Linde develops robust encoders, sensors and system electronics for position and speed feedback in demanding industrial applications.
fullDescription: Leine & Linde AB is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a supplier of encoder and sensor solutions for heavy-duty industrial environments.
Its documented portfolio includes incremental and absolute rotary encoders, linear position products, speed monitoring equipment and system electronics used for position and speed feedback.

profiles.shortDescription: ANEST IWATA manufactures air compressors, vacuum equipment, spray equipment and industrial coating systems.
fullDescription: ANEST IWATA Corporation is verified through its official corporate profile as a Japanese manufacturer whose predecessor, Iwata Seisakusho, was founded in 1926.
Its documented businesses cover oil-free air compressors, scroll and piston vacuum pumps, spray guns, paint-feeding equipment, coating systems and related peripheral equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Desco Industries manufactures ESD-control products, electronics rework equipment and related workplace materials.
fullDescription: Desco Industries Inc. is verified through its manufacturer-owned company profile as a United States industrial group established in 1979, with roots in Delta Electrical Specialty Company.

Its documented product groups include ESD bags, wrist straps, mats, garments, flooring, ionizers, monitors, testers, rework machines, dispensing products and specialist tools for electronics manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: Egger Pumps manufactures centrifugal and vortex pumps plus diaphragm control valves for solids-laden and sensitive fluids.
fullDescription: Emile Egger & Cie SA is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as an independent Swiss pump company operating since 1947.
The official portfolio includes Turo vortex pumps, process and wastewater pumps, elbow propeller pumps and Iris diaphragm control valves for municipal and industrial fluid handling.

profiles.shortDescription: Elbe Group manufactures drive shafts, cardan shafts, universal joints and flanges for vehicles and industrial machinery.
fullDescription: Elbe Group is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a German family-owned producer of drive solutions with roots dating to 1919.
Its official range covers cardan and centred drive shafts, double joints, precision universal-joint shafts, ball-joint shafts, sensory drive shafts, spiders, rigid shafts and drive flanges.

profiles.shortDescription: Franz Haas is a legacy Bühler equipment brand associated with industrial wafer, biscuit and confectionery production systems.
fullDescription: FHW Franz Haas Waffelmaschinen is verified through Bühler's official acquisition notice as part of the Haas Group, which joined Bühler in 2017 after developing wafer-machinery activities over many decades.
Official Bühler material continues to document Franz Haas wafer-baking technology and the former group's scope across wafer, biscuit, ice-cream-cone, cake and confectionery production systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Hänchen manufactures hydraulic cylinders, test actuators, rod-clamping units and customised drive systems.
fullDescription: Herbert Hänchen GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a German family business founded in 1925 and focused on hydraulic drive technology.
Its documented range includes standard, servo and custom hydraulic cylinders, test actuators, rod-clamping units, machine elements and special-purpose machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: HERMETIC develops sealless canned-motor, magnetic-drive and vacuum pumps for critical process fluids.
fullDescription: HERMETIC-Pumpen GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a developer and manufacturer of hermetically sealed pumping technologies.

Its documented portfolio includes canned-motor pumps, magnetic-drive pumps and vacuum pumps for chemical, petrochemical, energy and refrigeration processes where leak-tight fluid handling is required.

profiles.shortDescription: Hobart manufactures commercial dishwashing, food-preparation, weighing and wrapping equipment for foodservice and food retail.
fullDescription: Hobart Corporation is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as an ITW Food Equipment Group brand serving commercial foodservice and food-retail operations.
The official portfolio includes warewashing systems, mixers and food-preparation machines, commercial cooking equipment, scales, wrapping systems and retail software.

profiles.shortDescription: JAKSA manufactures solenoid valves and coils for industrial fluid and gas control, including high-pressure duties.
fullDescription: JAKSA is verified through manufacturer-issued technical documentation bearing the company's Ljubljana, Slovenia identity.
Its documented portfolio includes direct-acting and pilot-operated solenoid valves, high-pressure valve variants, valve coils and related accessories for controlling liquids and gases.

profiles.shortDescription: Emmerich develops piston-diaphragm pumps for abrasive, corrosive, solids-laden and shear-sensitive industrial media.
fullDescription: EMMERICH GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned website and official legacy brochure as the successor identity of Josef Emmerich Pumpenfabrik, founded in 1945.
Its official product scope centres on modular piston-diaphragm pumps and high-pressure variants for filter-press feeding and demanding fluid-transfer processes.

profiles.shortDescription: MAC Valves manufactures pneumatic and fluid valves, proportional flow controls, pulse valves and dosing pumps.
fullDescription: MAC Valves, Inc. is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a United States industrial valve manufacturer with more than 75 years of activity.
Its documented range includes multi-way pneumatic valves, Bullet Valve cartridges, liquid and media-separated valves, proportional flow controls, pulse valves, fieldbus platforms and dosing pumps.

profiles.shortDescription: Montabert manufactures hydraulic breakers, hydraulic drifters and demolition attachments for construction and mining equipment.
fullDescription: Montabert is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a French hydraulic-equipment company founded in 1921 and based near Lyon.
Its official range includes compact through heavy hydraulic breakers, hydraulic drifters, pneumatic equipment and demolition attachments such as processors, grapples, shears and pulverizers.

profiles.shortDescription: Nabtesco develops precision reduction gears and motion-control equipment for robotics, transport and industrial machinery.
fullDescription: Nabtesco Corporation is verified through its official corporate and precision-equipment pages as a Japanese company established in 2003.

Its documented businesses include precision cycloidal reduction gears, railway and commercial-vehicle equipment, marine controls, aircraft equipment, automatic doors, packaging machines and other motion-control systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Merkle-Korff is a Nidec brand for compact DC gearmotors used in commercial, industrial and equipment applications.
fullDescription: Merkle-Korff Industries is verified on Nidec's official motor platform as a long-established small-motor and gearmotor brand founded in 1911.
The current official scope covers compact DC gearmotors designed to provide reduced output speed and increased torque for equipment and automation duties.

profiles.shortDescription: NETZSCH develops analytical instruments, grinding and dispersing systems, and positive-displacement pumping and dosing equipment.
fullDescription: NETZSCH Group is verified through its official company pages as a family-owned German enterprise founded in 1873 in Selb.
Its three documented business units cover thermal analysis and rheology instruments, grinding and dispersing technologies, and positive-displacement pumps and dosing systems for industrial processes.

profiles.shortDescription: PCM develops positive-displacement pumps and fluid-handling systems for transfer, dosing, mixing and difficult industrial media.
fullDescription: PCM SA is verified through its official company material as a French pump manufacturer established around René Moineau's progressing-cavity technology and operating within Gévelot.

The documented industrial portfolio includes progressing-cavity, peristaltic and diaphragm dosing pumps, hopper pumps, grinders and macerators for abrasive, viscous, corrosive and solids-laden fluids.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHMITT Kreiselpumpen manufactures corrosion-resistant centrifugal pumps for aggressive industrial fluids.
fullDescription: SCHMITT-Kreiselpumpen is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a German specialist in industrial centrifugal pumps for acids, alkalis and other corrosive media since 1964.
Its official range includes horizontal and vertical plastic pumps, stainless-steel centrifugal pumps and standardized chemical pumps for process, environmental and manufacturing applications.

profiles.shortDescription: SEALPAC develops tray-sealing, thermoforming and semi-automatic packaging equipment for food production.
fullDescription: SEALPAC GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a packaging-machine producer based in Oldenburg, Germany.
The official range covers automated tray sealers, thermoformers and semi-automatic tray-sealing equipment for fresh food, prepared meals and other food-packaging processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Simatek develops industrial bag-filter systems and controls for emission control, dust collection and powder recovery.
fullDescription: Simatek A/S is verified through its manufacturer-owned company profile as a Danish producer of industrial emission, air-pollution-control and product-recovery systems.

Its documented portfolio includes process and aspiration bag filters, pulse-jet filters, high-temperature filtration, dust-collection systems and filter controllers for food, cement, mineral, chemical and energy processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Trelleborg develops engineered polymer solutions, sealing systems and fluid-handling products for demanding industrial applications.
fullDescription: Trelleborg AB is verified through its official group pages as a Swedish engineered-polymer company with production origins in 1896 and head office in Trelleborg.
Its business areas supply industrial polymer solutions, medical components and sealing systems, including hoses, couplings, expansion joints, sheeting, wear protection and engineered seals.

profiles.shortDescription: Vacuum Barrier Corporation engineers liquid-nitrogen dosing and vacuum-insulated cryogenic piping systems.
fullDescription: Vacuum Barrier Corporation is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a cryogenic-equipment company active since 1958.

Its documented systems include liquid-nitrogen dosing equipment, phase separators and vacuum-insulated piping for packaging, food processing, biotechnology, pharmaceutical and other cryogenic transfer applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Vanzetti Engineering designs and manufactures centrifugal, reciprocating and submerged cryogenic pumps.
fullDescription: Vanzetti Engineering is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as an Italian cryogenic-pump OEM established in 1984 and headquartered in Cavallerleone.

Its official range includes centrifugal, reciprocating, submerged and retractable in-tank pumps for LNG and other cryogenic-liquid duties across marine, automotive, industrial and aerospace applications.

profiles.shortDescription: VARIOVAC develops thermoforming, tray-sealing, chamber and package-marking systems for food, medical and non-food products.
fullDescription: VARIOVAC PS SystemPack GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a German packaging-machine company founded in 1970.
Its official portfolio covers thermoforming packaging machines, tray sealers, chamber machines, package marking and testing equipment, line convergers, dosing systems and gas-analysis accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Westcar manufactures fluid, elastic and flexible couplings, mechanical brakes and electronic starting and braking devices.
fullDescription: Westcar S.r.l. is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as an Italian power-transmission company manufacturing mechanical couplings since 1978.
The official range includes hydrodynamic fluid couplings, elastic and flexible couplings, drum and disc brakes, soft starters and DC-injection brake units for industrial drives.

profiles.shortDescription: Outotec is a legacy Metso product and technology brand associated with minerals processing and metals-refining equipment.
fullDescription: Outotec is verified through Metso's official corporate notices as a predecessor company that combined with Metso Minerals in 2020; Metso Outotec was renamed Metso Corporation in 2023.

Metso states that Outotec continues as a product brand for selected technologies, while the current company supplies equipment and process solutions for aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining.

profiles.shortDescription: Perske designs and manufactures customer-specific high-speed electric motors and direct drives.
fullDescription: Walter Perske GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a German special-motor producer operating in Mannheim since 1947.

Its documented scope covers customer-specific high-speed direct drives and special induction motors from prototypes through series production, with direct tool mounting and application-specific shaft designs.

profiles.shortDescription: RefComp manufactures semi-hermetic screw and reciprocating compressors for refrigeration, air conditioning and heat-pump systems.
fullDescription: RefComp is verified through its official brand site as an Italian compressor business founded in Lonigo in 1991 and currently part of Fujian Snowman.
Its documented portfolio includes semi-hermetic screw and piston compressors for industrial and commercial refrigeration, air conditioning, process cooling and heat-pump applications.

profiles.shortDescription: SMIPACK manufactures automatic and semi-automatic shrink-wrapping, sealing and flow-pack packaging machines.
fullDescription: SMIPACK S.p.A. is verified through official company material as the SMI Group business specialised in packaging machinery since 1997.
Its documented portfolio includes L-seal hood packers, modular L-seal machines, shrink wrappers, flow-pack machines and handle applicators for food and non-food products.

profiles.shortDescription: SOTRAS manufactures industrial filters and separators for compressors, vacuum pumps, hydraulics and compressed-air systems.
fullDescription: SOTRAS S.r.l. is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as an Italian industrial-filtration company active since 1975.

Its official range includes compressor air/oil separators, vacuum-pump demisters and air filters, refrigeration and natural-gas filters, hydraulic and compressed-air filters, dust cartridges and service kits.

profiles.shortDescription: WayCon develops sensors for position, displacement, distance and vibration measurement in industry and research.
fullDescription: WayCon Positionsmesstechnik GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a German developer and manufacturer of precision position and distance measurement systems.

Its official range includes draw-wire sensors, LVDTs, linear scales, potentiometers, encoders, laser and ultrasonic sensors, magnetostrictive transducers, magnetic scales and inductive, eddy-current and capacitive sensors.

profiles.shortDescription: Weforma develops industrial shock absorbers, rotary dampers, air springs and vibration-isolation components.
fullDescription: Weforma Dämpfungstechnik GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned site as a German specialist in deceleration and vibration technology for machinery and plant engineering.

Its documented portfolio covers industrial and heavy-duty shock absorbers, elevator buffers, deceleration cylinders, speed controls, rotary dampers, pallet stoppers, gas springs, air springs, PUR buffers and metal cushions.

profiles.shortDescription: Nikkiso ACD supplies centrifugal and reciprocating cryogenic pumps for industrial gases, LNG and related transfer duties.
fullDescription: ACD Cryo is verified through Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases' official product pages as the Nikkiso ACD cryogenic-pump product line.

The documented range includes centrifugal and reciprocating pumps, submerged and in-tank configurations, vertical-turbine pumps and related cryogenic transfer equipment for LNG, nitrogen, oxygen, ethylene, hydrogen and carbon dioxide.

profiles.shortDescription: BOLL & KIRCH manufactures industrial filters for liquid and gas filtration across marine, energy and process applications.
fullDescription: Boll & Kirch Filterbau GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned website as a German producer of customised industrial filtration systems with more than 75 years of experience.

The official product and document range includes automatic backflushing filters, simplex and duplex filters, water-treatment filtration, differential-pressure monitoring and cleaning equipment for liquid and gas duties.

profiles.shortDescription: Char-Lynn is a Danfoss brand of low-speed, high-torque orbital hydraulic motors for mobile and industrial machinery.
fullDescription: Char-Lynn is verified through Danfoss' official product pages as a hydraulic-motor brand within the Danfoss Power Solutions portfolio.
The documented range includes spool-valve and disc-valve orbital motors for agriculture, construction, material handling, food processing and other heavy-duty machine functions.

profiles.shortDescription: Mehrer manufactures oil-free piston and diaphragm compressors plus engineered systems for process gases.
fullDescription: Mehrer Compression GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned history as a German compressor company founded in 1889 by Josef Mehrer.

Its official range includes oil-free reciprocating and diaphragm compressors, packaged compressor systems and food-line configurations for gas recovery, recycling, transfer, filling and high-pressure process duties.

profiles.shortDescription: Landustrie develops pumps, aeration, screening and sludge-treatment equipment for water and wastewater systems.
fullDescription: Landustrie is verified through its official website as one of Noardling's water-technology brands, with design and manufacturing activities in Sneek, Netherlands.
Its documented product range includes sewage and centrifugal pumps, Archimedes screw pumps, aerators, flow boosters, screens, clarifiers, sludge thickeners and water-treatment equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Linde Hydraulics, now LHY Powertrain, develops hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, electronic controls and modular drive systems.
fullDescription: Linde Hydraulics is verified through the official LHY Powertrain history as the former company name; the manufacturer adopted LHY Powertrain in 2025.
The current official range covers high-pressure hydraulic pumps and motors, valves, electronic controls, peripheral devices and integrated powertrain systems for mobile and industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: METRUS develops pressure and tightness test benches, online valve-testing equipment and valve-test software.
fullDescription: METRUS GmbH is verified through its manufacturer-owned company history as the current identity connected with the former LS-Mechanik test-bench business.
Its documented scope includes pressure and leak-test benches for valves and pressure vessels, online valve-testing systems, mechanical measuring levers and dedicated testing software.

profiles.shortDescription: NERAK manufactures vertical conveyors and elevators for unit loads, bulk materials and baggage handling.
fullDescription: NERAK is verified through its manufacturer-owned sites as a developer of vertical conveying systems built around its rubber-block-chain technology.

The official range includes continuous and reciprocating vertical conveyors, circulating conveyors, platform lifts, C- and S-conveyors, vertical sorters and bucket elevators for unit loads and bulk materials.

profiles.shortDescription: PFM Packaging Machinery designs flow-wrapping, form-fill-seal and automated packaging systems for food and non-food products.
fullDescription: P.F.M. S.p.A. is verified through its manufacturer-owned group pages as an Italian flexible-packaging machinery company founded in 1964 and headquartered in Torrebelvicino.
Its documented portfolio includes horizontal flow wrappers, vertical form-fill-seal machines, stand-up-pouch systems, automatic feeding systems, multihead weighers and complete packaging lines.
